subject: Recast demo timing to match CTO onsite window
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightworks.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request to move demo — CTO onsite week of Mar 22

Hi Sean,

Quick one — our CTO is going to be onsite in SF the week of March 22 for customer briefings and we were hoping to have them join the product demo with your team. We currently have the demo scheduled for March 18, and the CTO won't be back in town until the 23rd.

Would it be possible to shift the demo to any slot during the week of 22nd (Mon/Tue preferred)? If getting the CTO live is difficult, is there a short alternative where the CTO can join the final 20 minutes only?

We're still moving a few internal pieces around so I can be flexible on timing. Appreciate any options you can propose.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Principal Product Manager
BrightWorks

Attachment: cto_travel_overview.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request to move demo — CTO onsite week of Mar 22

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Alex's note. CTO wants to be onsite week of 22nd and prefers Mon/Tue. Current demo is Mar 18.

Can we:
- Propose two concrete replacement slots (one morning, one late-afternoon) that match the customer's timezone (PST)
- Confirm who can present if CTO only joins the last 15–20 mins (I can do CTO handoff + Q&A, Marissa can cover the technical deep dive)
- Prep a short 10–15 min pre-demo sync if they want to run through key points with the CTO first.

Karthik — can you share your availability on Mon/Tue 22–23?

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightworks.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move demo — CTO onsite week of Mar 22

Alex — thanks for the heads up. We can absolutely recast the slot. Two options that work for the delivery team (all times PT):

Option A: Mon, Mar 22 • 09:30–10:30 AM PT — full demo + 15-min CTO Q&A at the end
Option B: Tue, Mar 23 • 04:00–05:00 PM PT — full demo; CTO can join last 20 mins for Q&A

If the customer wants the CTO present for the full session, we can prioritize Option A. If the CTO prefers a shorter window, Option B keeps a late-career slot that may be easier to accommodate.

I'll attach the latest agenda and a short technical appendix for the CTO. Sean — can you confirm who will lead the opening 20 minutes and who should run the technical deep dive? Also, do we want to offer a 15-min prep call with the CTO ahead of the demo (we could do Fri, Mar 19 or Mon morning before the demo)?

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF, 14KB); technical-appendix.docx (DOCX, 28KB)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer (Sales Engineering)
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move demo — CTO onsite week of Mar 22

Thanks Marissa — both options look good. CTO would prefer Option A (Mon, Mar 22 09:30 PT) but only if we can guarantee a 30–40 minute block where they can be actively engaged in architecture and data handling discussion. If that won't be possible, we'll take Option B and have the CTO join the last 20 minutes.

Also: can we do a 20-min pre-demo sync on Mon, Mar 22 at 08:30 PT with the CTO and our internal engineering lead to align on the architecture topics? I've attached the CTO's travel itinerary and a calendar stub.

Confirming: please send a calendar invite and updated agenda for the Mon slot and we'll lock it.

Appreciate it — see you (virtually) soon.

Alex Moreno
Principal Product Manager, BrightWorks
Attachment: cto_travel_itinerary.ics (Calendar invite, 2KB)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move demo — CTO onsite week of Mar 22

Alex — great, locking in Option A. Calendar invite and updated agenda attached; I've blocked a 20-min pre-demo sync immediately before the demo for the CTO + your eng lead (Mon, Mar 22 • 08:30–08:50 PT).

Summary / action items:
- Demo: Mon, Mar 22 • 09:30–10:30 AM PT (Redwood Zoom link) — invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
- Pre-demo sync: Mon, Mar 22 • 08:30–08:50 AM PT (quick alignment call)
- Presenters: Sean — opening & roadmap (first 15 mins)
  Marissa — technical deep dive (15–30 mins)
  CTO — architecture Q&A (last 30–40 mins)
- Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf; redwood-demo-invite.ics

If the CTO's schedule changes, we'll fallback to Option B and ensure they at least join the final 20 minutes. See you Monday.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-demo-invite.ics (Calendar invite, 3KB)
